__comment__: Example for future services: Add users with a password_hash, create a vhost for the service, and map permissions connecting the user to the vhost. Example: {"users": [{"name": "service_a", "password_hash": "base64_hash_here", "tags": []}], "vhosts": [{"name": "service_a_vhost"}], "permissions": [{"user": "service_a", "vhost": "service_a_vhost", "configure": ".*", "write": ".*", "read": ".*"}]}
